Docs.summary: Provides types to store identity credentials and retrieve their data for presentation to a reader.

remarks.para: Use to access the credential store. Credentials contain data entries grouped by namespace and access control profiles that specify the conditions for access.
The credential-specific application implements the presentation and verification protocols. Hardware-backed identity credential storage is not available on all devices.
The Android reference deprecates in API level 37.2 and recommends with the Android hardware-backed keystore instead.
See the Android identity package reference and the Android credential store reference.
